propositions: Plan-review Pass 1 can collapse a failed criterion to an empty success and checkpoint it, losing operational context around policy, prompt, contract, and topology inputs.
Current checkpoint identity omits material inputs (policy, prompt, contract, topology) causing trustworthy partial results to be unrecoverable.

Plan-review must migrate from legacy discovery topology to a journaled shared kernel (S2) that executes DiscoveryStagePlan units while preserving existing YAML topology, facet packing, concurrency, and cancellation behavior.

The new checkpoint key must change when any material input (code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model, topology, context, dependency, namespace) changes, and corrupt or legacy entries must produce zero reuse.
Failed, cancelled, skipped, and budget-shed work cannot serialize as clean checkpoints and remain missing across reruns, while earlier successes and independent work survive.
The final verdict (BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/PASS) must follow the approved failure policy: preserve successful findings, skip dependents of missing work, and allow advisory-only gaps to pass.
